screen.practice: timing of patient chatbot use before vs after visit
screen.reason: This is a randomized trial testing patient use of a generative AI chatbot (ChatGPT-4o) before vs after clinical visits compared to usual care to evaluate its impact on decisional conflict and patient experience.

primary.practice: timing of patient-facing chatbot use (pre-visit vs post-visit)
